name: HiAi Observe Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted observability software with error tracking, uptime checks, Docker logs, OpenTelemetry traces and metrics, public status pages, and AI tracing; no published software usage quota or expiry. Runs on user-provided infrastructure.
watch_out: Self-hosted software only: VPS, storage, SMTP notifications, and external integrations may cost extra. Configure authentication, TLS, secrets, backups and public endpoints before production use; project maturity and upstream deployment claims require operator validation.
